mainEntity.name: What is a foundation-based tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A foundation-based tiny home is a small, permanent dwelling constructed on a traditional concrete foundation, similar to a standard house. Unlike tiny homes on wheels, these structures are considered real property and are subject to local building codes and zoning regulations. This type of tiny home offers greater stability, a longer lifespan, and often qualifies for traditional mortgages, providing a more permanent housing solution than a mobile alternative. They are designed for long-term residency and integration into a community.
